papers.title: Temperature-dependent Fano response and higher-order anharmonicity in single-crystal tellurium
papers.abstract: In single-crystal trigonal Te, the low-temperature Fano line shape of the Raman-active A1 mode reflects interference between the phonon and an electronic continuum, whereas four-phonon scattering substantially shortens the lifetimes of low-frequency heat-carrying phonons and lowers the lattice thermal conductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。判断依据：摘要中同时涉及“低温Fano线形”的实验观测（Raman光谱）与“四声子散射”的理论/计算分析。；研究对象：单晶三方碲（trigonal Te），具体研究其拉曼活性A1模的Fano共振行为，以及低频导热声子的非谐性衰减机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单晶Te中，低温下A1模的Fano线形源于声子与电子连续谱的干涉；同时，四声子散射显著缩短了低频载热声子的寿命，从而降低了晶格热导率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单晶Te中，低温下A1模的Fano线形源于声子与电子连续谱的干涉；同时，四声子散射显著缩短了低频载热声子的寿命，从而降低了晶格热导率。；创新点：将A1模的Fano干涉效应与四阶非谐性（四声子过程）对热输运的贡献在同一材料中关联起来，揭示了电子-声子干涉与高阶声子散射共同影响碲的振动和热学性质。摘要未突出说明更细分的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 低温拉曼光谱（用于观测Fano线形）；声子非谐性理论计算（用于分析四声子散射过程及其对声子寿命和热导率的影响）。摘要未明确说明具体计算框架（如DFT级别或玻尔兹曼输运方程求解细节）。

papers.title: Fermi surface studies of altermagnetic CrSb from Shubnikov–de Haas oscillations
papers.abstract: The authors present here results from electrical magnetotransport measurements on microstructures of altermagnetic CrSb in pulsed fields up to 68 T. They study the temperature and field-orientation dependence of magnetic quantum oscillations in combination with first-principles calculations. The observed frequency spectrum agrees well with density functional theory calculations that take spin-orbit coupling into account, without invoking significant ad hoc band shifts. The findings validate the predicted electronic band structure of CrSb hosting multiple semimetallic bands and a locally alternating spin polarization.

papers.abstract: A precessing magnetic dipole realizes source-driven spin dynamics in the near field, while bichromatic two-wave interference additionally produces nutation. papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：进动的磁偶极子在近场中可实现源驱动的自旋动力学，而双色双波干涉可额外产生章动（nutation）；通过广义自旋连续性方程可证明光学自旋源以“力矩”形式作用于磁化动力学，从而在光子自旋与磁化进动之间建立直接联系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。

papers.title: Class $C$ quantum network model with random tunneling and its nonlinear sigma model representation
papers.abstract: The spin quantum Hall effect is the superconducting counterpart of the integer quantum Hall effect. Here, the authors derive the long-distance nonlinear sigma model for a quantum network with random tunneling between chiral links carrying N channels. Strong even–odd tunneling asymmetry breaks the saddle point down. Also, the triplet sector stays coupled to the singlet one and can turn anomalously soft. The longitudinal and spin Hall conductances can be tuned independently, giving a flexible platform for class-C localization.

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使在一个仅包含单个Kerr非线性腔的最小系统中，非线性本身也能内在产生新的拓扑奇异性结构，并导致拓扑奇异性出现层级结构（hierarchy）。；创新点：首次证明非线性本身（而非仅作为微扰）能够内在生成新的拓扑奇异性，打破了以往认为非线性仅能调控或修饰线性拓扑结构的认知。摘要未突出说明其与具体已有工作的对比细节。
